metadata.description: Additional fields for custom types or extension fields

validate.description: Run QA validation after save and return issues. Also runs automatically if KB has qa_on_write: true in kb.yaml.

fips.description: Filter by county FIPS code (5-digit, e.g. '12086' for Miami-Dade). Works across all KBs.

tags.description: Filter by tags (entries must have ALL specified tags)

tree.description: Return hierarchical tree instead of flat list

kb_names.description: Limit the timeline to these KBs. Omit for every KB the caller can read; an empty list is refused.

status.description: Only entries whose status matches, the effective status: a task whose children are all resolved counts as done while its file still says open (or in_progress).

append.description: Add one item to a list field without sending the list: {field: item}; a list value appends each item. Links: {"links": {"target": "id", "relation": "related_to"}}. The other items keep their bytes.

metadata.description: Fields by name (a key here is the field of that name, ADR-0051); a managed field is refused

remove.description: Remove one item equal to the value from a list field: {field: item}; a list value removes each item.

tags.description: Replaces the whole tag list; to add or drop one tag use `append`/`remove`

unset.description: Remove these keys from the frontmatter, with their own lines. Sending null as a field's value sets it to null; it does not remove the key.
